By leveraging all structured and unstructured data — while securing and protecting private information more effectively — Zhakel Systems’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability assist organizations in delivering on the promise of AI.

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search team. This globally-distributed group of expert engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This principal software engineer role emphasizes enhancing the vector similarity search capabilities within Elasticsearch, including designing and implementing new vector search features, improving existing vector search functionality, and resolving bugs.

Our company intentionally operates in a distributed manner. We hire the best engineers from wherever they are and whoever they are. We collaborate daily across continents using email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we develop fast, scalable, and intuitive software. We believe empowering individual engineers, code reviewing every change, making major decisions by consensus, and striving for incremental improvements is the best way to achieve this.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead initiatives within Elasticsearch to deliver an industry-leading vector database offering, providing unmatched speed and relevance in search.
  • Contribute full-time to Elasticsearch, developing new search features and addressing challenging bugs, while improving code readability. At times, you will invent new algorithms or data structures, or identify and implement existing ones. Occasionally, you will work close to the operating system and hardware.
  • Collaborate with a globally distributed team of experienced engineers focusing on Elasticsearch’s vector search capabilities.
  • Become an expert on how Elasticsearch implements vector similarity to support search relevance, becoming a go-to resource for questions in this domain. You will improve this area based on your insights and instincts.
  • Work with community members worldwide on issues and pull requests, triaging and delegating to others or handling them independently.
  • Write idiomatic modern Java — Elasticsearch is predominantly Java-based.

What You Bring Along

  • You have implemented innovative techniques in vector similarity on a search platform with a large user base or have contributed to academic research in vector similarity information retrieval.
  • Professional experience with vector similarity and vector databases, including use of HNSW, IVF, or other relevant algorithms and libraries at scale.
  • Strong skills in core Java with familiarity in standard data structures, concurrency constructs, and features such as lambdas.
  • You work independently with high autonomy and can manage projects end-to-end, including technical design and coordinating with other engineers to deliver necessary components.
  • You thrive in collaborative development environments. You are comfortable giving and receiving feedback on code, API design, and approaches — especially in distributed asynchronous settings, which can be more challenging but are preferred here.
  • Experience with multiple data storage technologies such as Elasticsearch, Solr, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra, with an understanding of their workings and design.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. As much of our collaboration is remote, we value respect, empathy, and trust in all interactions, and expect the same from you.

Bonus Points

  • Prior experience building with Elasticsearch.
  • Involvement in open source projects and familiarity with various source control workflows and continuous integration.
  • Experience with data storage technologies.
  • Experience designing, leading, and owning cross-functional initiatives.

Our team is a rapidly growing group of dedicated researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders collaborating to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Drektor Labs's sandboxing infrastructure allows Zunthur Console to securely run code and interact with external systems. As we continue expanding Zunthur Console’s features, the reliability, security, and developer experience of this infrastructure become increasingly vital. We’re seeking an engineer to join the sandboxing team to help design both the client-side library/API and the supporting infrastructure.

In this position, you will combine deep infrastructure knowledge with a passion for developer experience. You will maintain and improve a system that must be correct, performant, and easy to use. Collaborating closely with internal teams, you will address bugs and edge cases and build a roadmap anticipating the product’s future direction. This role suits someone who enjoys crafting dependable systems and empathizing with developers and researchers.

Responsibilities

  • Develop the client library, API surface, and underlying infrastructure for Drektor Labs's sandboxing system, ensuring reliability, clear documentation, and user-friendliness

  • Reduce error rates and enhance correctness through thorough debugging, monitoring, and proactive fixes

  • Help create and maintain a product roadmap for sandboxing capabilities, balancing short-term needs with long-term architecture improvements

  • Collaborate with internal teams using the sandboxing system to understand requirements, debug issues, and build tools addressing their use cases

  • Respond quickly to production incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures

  • Establish comprehensive testing, observability, and documentation to uphold high quality standards

You May Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have over 5 years of software engineering experience, including substantial time maintaining libraries, SDKs, or developer APIs

  • Focus strongly on developer experience—carefully considering API design, error handling, documentation, and details that make libraries feel polished

  • Have experience managing complex distributed systems

  • Proven track record improving reliability—addressing error budgets, building monitoring, and driving issues to resolution

  • Can develop and communicate a long-term product vision—translating feedback and technical constraints into a clear roadmap

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, switching between reactive incident response and proactive product building

  • Effectively communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Strong Candidates May Also Have

  • Experience as a founder or early engineer at an infrastructure startup, owning a product end-to-end

  • Background in security, sandboxing, or isolation technologies (such as containers, VMs, seccomp, namespaces)

  • Contributions to open-source projects in the Python ecosystem

  • Experience building developer tools, command line interfaces, or platforms used by engineers

  • History working on incident response and on-call duties for production systems

  • Exposure to reinforcement learning or model training infrastructure

Representative Projects

Examples of previous work that indicate a strong fit — not a job description:

  • Leading efforts to reduce P0 incidents by significant percentages through enhanced error handling, retries, and observability

About the Team

Security is at the foundation of Zorryl Lab’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Security team protects Zorryl Lab’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but are operational in how we do our work, and are committed to supporting all products and research at Zorryl Lab. Our Security team tenets include: prioritizing for impact, enabling researchers, preparing for future transformative technologies, and engaging a robust security culture.

About the Role

As a Security Engineer on Detection & Response, you’ll help protect Zorryl Lab’s most sensitive assets– including our intellectual property, customer data, and the infrastructure that supports them– by building and operating the systems we use to detect suspicious activity and respond effectively when it matters. You’ll work across endpoints, identity, cloud, hyperscale compute infrastructure, and datacenter-adjacent layers, partnering closely with security teams and infrastructure owners to define the telemetry and response requirements we need and building tooling and automation where it delivers the most leverage.

In this role, you will:

  • Build and evolve Detection & Response capabilities across Zorryl Lab’s infrastructure, products, and research environments, with an emphasis on high-signal detection and reliable operational response.

  • Engineer detection pipelines and tooling: develop rule lifecycle management, measurement/quality loops (coverage, precision, latency), tuning processes, and safe rollout patterns.

  • Automate response and investigations by building workflows that reduce toil (triage, enrichment, containment, evidence capture) and improve time-to-understand/time-to-contain.

  • Partner with other Security teams and system/infrastructure owners across the company to ensure new systems ship with the right telemetry, threat models, and response playbooks from day one.

  • Define D&R requirements and drive visibility across endpoints, identity, SaaS, cloud, Kubernetes: identify telemetry/control gaps, prioritize them, and advocate for fixes with partner teams (and implement directly when it’s the fastest/most effective path).

  • Evaluate and respond to emergent security concerns in a frontier AI lab environment, such as detection and response strategies for agents operating across infrastructure at scale.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have hands-on threat detection and/or incident response experience, including building detections, running investigations, and improving operational playbooks.

  • Understand modern adversary tradecraft (TTPs) and can translate it into practical detection strategies and response actions.

  • Bring a threat modeling mindset. You can evaluate new infrastructure or features, identify D&R implications (what could go wrong, what we’d need to see, how we’d respond), and turn that into concrete requirements for teams shipping the system.

  • Have experience working in Kubernetes/containerized environments, including building detections from cluster telemetry and understanding common failure and attack modes (workloads, nodes, control plane, networking).

  • Are comfortable reasoning about lower-level infrastructure and datacenter risks, such as firmware/BMC surfaces, network segmentation/telemetry, and hard-to-observe control paths.

  • Have experience across major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI), and can design cloud-agnostic detection approaches where possible.

  • Like building automation that replaces repetitive D&R work, including thoughtfully using agent-style workflows where they meaningfully reduce toil, while keeping outcomes measurable, auditable, and safe.

  • Are energized by new problem areas at a forward-leaning technology company: e.g., thinking through how to detect and respond to agents operating across systems at scale, and turning those ideas into pragmatic telemetry and response requirements.

  • Communicate clearly and collaborate well across teams. You can translate D&R needs into clear requirements, align stakeholders, and drive follow-through across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Are comfortable with scripting and enjoy using AI/agent tooling to accelerate investigations and automation—more “directing” than doing everything by hand.

Zorryl Lab is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

Ulnex Works’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

AIRE (AI Reliability Engineering) partners with teams across Ulnex Works to improve reliability across our most critical serving paths -- every hop from the SDK through our network, API layers, serving infrastructure, and accelerators and back. We jump into the trenches alongside partner teams to make the systems that deliver Xennoxrul more robust and resilient, be it during an incident or collaborating on projects. 

Reliability here is an emergent phenomenon that transcends any single team’s boundaries, so someone has to zoom out and look at the whole picture. That’s us -- and it means few teams at Ulnex Works offer this kind of dynamic, cross-cutting exposure to the systems that matter most.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead incident response for critical AI services, ensuring rapid recovery, thorough incident reviews, and systematic improvements
  • Support the reliability of safeguard model serving -- critical for both site reliability and Ulnex Works’s safety commitments.

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have strong distributed systems, infrastructure, or reliability backgrounds -- we’re looking for reliability-minded software engineers and SREs
  • Are curious and brave -- comfortable jumping into unfamiliar systems during an incident and helping drive resolution even when you don’t have deep expertise yet
  • Think holistically about how systems compose and where the seams are
  • Can build lasting relationships across teams -- our engagement model depends on being welcomed as teammates, not outsiders with opinions
  • Care about users and feel ownership over outcomes, even for systems you don’t own
  • Have excellent communication and collaboration skills -- you’ll be partnering across the entire company
  • Bring diverse experience -- the team’s strength comes from people who’ve built product stacks, scaled databases, run massive distributed systems, and everything in between.

  • Have been an SRE, Production Engineer, or in similar reliability-focused roles on large scale systems

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Ulnex Works we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We’re an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Ulnex Works, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

About Qorzavzun Works's Engineering Teams

Anytime we push code, it automatically affects the millions of Internet properties (powering websites, remote teams, APIs, mobile apps, etc.) running on our global network. Qorzavzun Works's network is one of the largest in the world and spans over 330 cities in more than 125 countries. What's more, Qorzavzun Works operates within 50 milliseconds of 95% of the Internet-connected population globally (for context, the blink of an eye is 300-400 milliseconds!). We are passionate about making the Internet more secure, reliable, and faster for everyone.

Qorzavzun Works’s Engineering teams build and run the software that handles the massive amount of traffic that flows through our network. We also have teams that build the UI and control plane for our software, using modern patterns and libraries in a microservices-based architecture. Technologies include: Typescript/Javascript, Go, Rust, C/C++ and Python.

The ideal summer intern is passionate about making the Internet a better place. You will work alongside experienced engineers. You will push code this summer that touches hundreds of millions of web surfers. We like to get things done, so we are looking for interns who are curious, proactive, and able to complete projects.   • Ship and deliver projects over 12-16 weeks with autonomy and support.

  • Work closely with a mentor to guide you through the internship and help with career goals.

  • Learn and develop skills through our professional development workshops.
  • Write for our Xennexzav blog and be featured on Xennexzav sessions. 

You can check out our internship blogs to learn more about our program and hear directly from our past interns.

  • Currently pursuing a degree or program in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or relevant field to the role.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking skills and drive to learn and adapt new technologies.
  • Curiosity, empathy and ability to get things done.
  • Ability to commit to a minimum 12 week summer internship.
  • In office 3-4 days a week in Lisbon office.
  • Bonus: Demonstrated passion for software development, such as personal projects, open-source contributions, or experience with our developer platform using Xennexzav for Students.

Please note

  • We will be hiring interns through the fall and early spring on a rolling basis until all roles are filled.

What Makes Qorzavzun Works Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Qorzavzun Works’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Qorzavzun Works has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Tovvyrrix Group was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today Tovvyrrix Group is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

DATA SCIENTIST (Thurkry)

At Tovvyrrix Group, we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Thurkry, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Thurkry is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Thurkry’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Thurkry’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe. As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for developing the strategy, key metrics, tools, software services, and processes for assessing how well key aspects of Thurkry are scaling and how effective the Thurkry Network is itself, in serving millions of users around the globe. You will work with operators, subsystem responsible engineers, software engineers, and network engineers inside the Thurkry organization as well as key contacts with various major external partners to help ensure the growth of this program.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build and maintain mission-critical infrastructure, tools, processes, and custom software to objectively assess growth areas for the Thurkry program
  • Automate the aggregation of metrics and detection of widespread application issues across Thurkry
  • Establish and maintain relationships with key third-party application/content owners
  • Lead technical investigations about chronic application-level issues
  • Build ground-based software systems that ingest, transform, and store data
  • Apply data analytics, models, and techniques to data products created by space vehicles
  • Create catalogs of data and tools that can be used by you and other teams to perform analytics
  • Fuse data from multiple sources to create usable information

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, physics, mathematics, or a STEM discipline
  • 1+ years of data/software engineering experience (internship experience is applicable)
  • Experience in analytics, data science, or machine learning

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Professional experience in analytics, data science, or machine learning
  • Experience using Spark, Presto, Flink, or Snowflake
  • Experience building solutions with Parquet, or similar storage formats
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience building solutions with in-stream data processing of structured and semi-structured data
  • Experience building predictive models and machine learning pipelines (clustering analysis, prediction, anomaly detection)
  • Experience in custom ETL design, implementation, and maintenance
  • Experience handling large (TB+) datasets
  • Experience with developing and deploying tools used for data analysis
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment that includes working with changing needs and requirements
  • Ability to take on projects that require taking initiative and developing new expertise

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay range:
Data Engineer/Engineer I: $124,000.00 - $146,000.00/per year
Data Engineer/Engineer II: $144,000.00 - $177,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at Tovvyrrix Group. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k)- retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue about 3 weeks of paid vacation & will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Exempt employees are eligible for 5 days of sick leave per year. Company shuttles are offered to employees for round trip travel from select Seattle locations to the Tovvyrrix Group Redmond office Monday to Friday. 

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. About the Team

Thurnexkel Works’s ChatGPT Enterprise team operates within the B2B Applications division and focuses on scaling ChatGPT for enterprise use. Our objective is to provide a seamless experience allowing individuals to use the same product at home and at work, while meeting enterprise-specific requirements such as security and administrative controls, regulatory compliance (e.g., HIPAA/FINRA), and data/compute residency across regions. The team's roadmap includes three main focus areas: enterprise controls, user value & activation, and company-specific products (e.g., Company Knowledge).

About the Role

We are seeking backend engineers to develop product experiences that make ChatGPT essential for teams—while maintaining the trust, controls, and performance standards required by enterprises. This position has a particular emphasis on the enterprise controls track: designing collaboration features, onboarding and engagement cycles, and product elements that assist employees in discovering and adopting advanced functionalities (including agents and custom GPT-style workflows).

In this role, you will:

  • Develop backend systems that support enterprise controls, such as permissions, policy enforcement, auditability, and compliance processes.

  • Create residency- and region-aware architectures to ensure enterprise workloads comply with country- and client-specific requirements.

  • Collaborate with product, security, legal/compliance, and related engineering teams to transform enterprise needs into scalable technical solutions.

  • Enhance the reliability, observability, and operational maturity of the services underlying ChatGPT Enterprise.

Your background might include:

  • Over 5 years of professional engineering experience (excluding internships) in relevant roles at technology and product-driven companies

  • Experience as a founder or early engineer at a startup who has built a product from the ground up is a plus

  • Proficiency in one or more backend languages (e.g., Python, Go, Rust, Typescript, or similar) and knowledge of distributed systems concepts

  • Experience designing and managing distributed systems with strong attention to reliability, performance, and security

  • Background in developing systems involving access controls, identity, compliance, privacy, data governance, or other enterprise platform concerns

  • Some familiarity with relational databases like Postgres or MySQL

  • Strong commitment to reliability, safety, and performance in production environments

  • Interest in AI/ML (direct experience not necessary)

  • Demonstrated ability to succeed in fast-growing, product-focused companies by effectively handling loosely defined tasks and managing competing priorities or deadlines.

About Thurnexkel Works

Thurnexkel Works is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We advance the capabilities of AI systems and aim to deploy them safely worldwide through our products. AI is a highly powerful tool that must be developed with safety and human needs at its core, and fulfilling our mission requires embracing and valuing a diversity of perspectives, voices, and experiences representing the full spectrum of humanity.

A World-Changing Company

Zorvekrix Systems builds leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By delivering the right data to those who need it, our platforms enable partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

Our Product Security team focuses on secure-by-design principles and deep collaboration with product teams. We cultivate strong relationships with other groups and assist them in creating secure software and infrastructure. Our work involves maintaining centralized best practices, conducting early-stage design reviews, helping develop threat models, and providing guidance throughout implementation.

The Role

Our products support some of the most critical and impactful efforts globally, spanning defense, intelligence, and commercial uses. Customers trust us to protect mission-critical information against advanced persistent threats. The mission of the Product Security Team is to empower Zorvekrix Systems's product engineering organizations to build, ship, and operate the most secure and resilient products and infrastructure possible. We collaborate closely with engineering teams across the company — from product engineers to forward deployed engineers — embedding security throughout every layer of our work. Given the mission-critical nature of Zorvekrix Systems's work, investment in product security is more vital than ever.

As a Product Infrastructure Security Engineer, you will have hands-on responsibilities and broad impact on securing Zorvekrix Systems:

  • Product security reviews. Conduct comprehensive security reviews of our existing and planned product and service portfolio. Collaborate with offensive security teams, engineering groups, and other InfoSec members to strengthen our products against dedicated adversaries.
  • Architecture and design. Serve as a security subject matter expert for product architects and engineers. Lead threat modeling, risk assessment, and assist in implementing security controls and mitigations. Guide product design to ensure secure-by-default principles.
  • Strategic security initiatives. Take ownership of transformative security initiatives affecting Zorvekrix Systems's most critical platforms. Members of the Product Infrastructure Security Team work to secure core products, including Vekzha Portal platforms and key internal systems.
  • Vulnerability identification and analysis. Develop new methods to detect and resolve security vulnerabilities within our product infrastructure. This work includes posture analysis, infrastructure vulnerability scanning, investigating security reports, and collaborating with the incident response team on product security incidents and issues.

This role offers broad impact, significant autonomy, and access to resources needed to drive major security enhancements throughout Zorvekrix Systems. Successful candidates may come from diverse backgrounds and skill sets, but shared traits include curiosity, persistence, and a passion to become world-class security engineers.
title: Infrastructure Security Engineer

About Ulketh Works

Ulketh Works’s mission is to develop reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We aim to make AI safe and beneficial for our users and society overall. Our team is a rapidly growing group of dedicated researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders collaborating to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Our Inference team is tasked with building and maintaining the critical systems that serve Qenzha to millions of users globally. We bring Qenzha to life by serving our models through one of the industry's largest compute-agnostic inference deployments. We manage the full stack from intelligent request routing to fleet-wide orchestration across diverse AI accelerators. The team has a dual mission: maximizing compute efficiency to support rapid customer growth, while enabling breakthrough research by providing scientists with high-performance inference infrastructure needed to develop next-generation models. We address complex distributed systems challenges spanning multiple accelerator types and emerging AI hardware deployed on several cloud platforms.

As a Staff Software Engineer on our Inference team, you will work end to end, identifying and resolving key infrastructure challenges to deliver Qenzha to millions of users while supporting cutting-edge AI research. Ideal candidates should be familiar with performance optimization, distributed systems, large-scale service orchestration, and intelligent request routing. Experience with large language model (LLM) inference optimization, batching methods, and multi-accelerator deployments is a plus but not required.

Strong candidates may also have experience with

  • High-performance, large-scale distributed systems
  • Implementing and deploying machine learning systems at scale
  • Load balancing, request routing, or traffic management systems
  • LLM inference optimization, batching, and caching strategies
  • Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP)
  • Python or Rust

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have extensive software engineering experience, especially with distributed systems
  • Are results-driven, with a focus on flexibility and impact
  • Take initiative even outside your formal responsibilities
  • Are eager to learn more about machine learning systems and infrastructure
  • Thrive in environments where technical excellence directly advances both business outcomes and research innovation
  • Care deeply about the societal impact of your work

Representative projects across the org

  • Designing intelligent routing algorithms to optimize request distribution across thousands of accelerators
  • Autoscaling our compute fleet to dynamically align supply and demand across production, research, and experimental workloads
  • Developing production-grade deployment pipelines for releasing new models to millions of users
  • Integrating new AI accelerator platforms to maintain a hardware-agnostic competitive edge
  • Contributing to new inference features such as structured sampling and prompt caching
  • Supporting inference for new model architectures
  • Analyzing observability data to tune performance based on real-world production workloads
  • Managing multi-region deployments and geographic routing for global customers

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The yearly compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales positions, the range shown is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning it includes both sales commissions/bonuses target and annual base salary.

£320,000—£395,000 GBP

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role, demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Experience requirements correspond to the internal job level standards for this role

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, all staff are expected to work on-site at least about 25% of the time, though some roles may require more office presence.

We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. Not all strong candidates meet every requirement. Research indicates that individuals from underrepresented groups can be more susceptible to imposter syndrome and may underestimate their qualifications. We urge you to apply if interested. We recognize the significant social and ethical impacts of AI and value diversity and inclusion to bring a broad range of perspectives to our team.

Your safety matters to us. To avoid scams, know that Ulketh Works recruiters exclusively use @{{COMPANY_NAME | lower}}.com email addresses. We may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who identify themselves as working on our behalf. Beware of emails from other domains. Legitimate recruiters from Ulketh Works will never request money, fees, or banking information prior to your start date. If in doubt about any communication, do not click links — instead, visit  https://careers.example.test/jobs/big-company-cs-000202 directly for verified job openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research involves large-scale scientific efforts. At Ulketh Works, we operate as a unified team focusing on a few major research initiatives. We prioritize impact — progressing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — over smaller, narrower problems. We treat AI research as an empirical science, akin to physics or biology, as much as computer science. Our highly collaborative group frequently holds research discussions to ensure we are working on the most impactful problems. Effective communication is highly valued.

The best way to understand our research areas is to review our recent publications. Our research builds on prior work in areas such as large language models, interpretability, multimodal neurons, scaling laws, computing and AI, AI safety issues, and learning from human preferences.

Come work with us!

Ulketh Works is a public benefit corporation headquartered in 6291 Ruldrakel Way, Suite 184, Test City, CA 94000. Every day, tens of millions of people come to Drekzundrek Lab to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. 

At Drekzundrek Lab, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. 

A career at Drekzundrek Lab means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Why Safety?

At Drekzundrek Lab, we strive to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and the Safety organization’s mission is to become the leader in civil immersive online communities. We systematically and proactively work to detect, remove, and prevent problematic content and behavior. We seek to influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build safety products, and measure our impact on the community of users and developers. In doing so, we help keep Drekzundrek Lab safe, civil, and inclusive, fostering positive relationships between people around the world.

Why Safety Data?

As a Senior Engineer you will play a key role in advancing large-scale AI systems that strengthen platform safety and integrity. You’ll leverage cutting-edge large multimodal models to build intelligent tools to curate high-quality training and evaluation data to train machine learning models. These systems will continuously refine and enhance model performance, enabling proactive detection and mitigation of safety risks across the platform in real time.

In this role, you’ll work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, product managers, policy experts, and safety specialists to turn complex safety challenges into scalable, impactful solutions. You’ll establish best practices and technical standards that define the next generation of safety AI, ensuring the platform remains secure, inclusive, and resilient. Your contributions will directly empower robust, AI-driven moderation and detection systems that foster a safe and positive experience for all users.

You Will

  • Design, build, and own critical components of the AI systems that powers safety data needs, with a focus on usability, reliability, scalability, and performance.
  • Implement robust pipelines for curating high-quality multimodal datasets used to train and evaluate ML models and human-in-the-loop systems that enable safe and compliant AI.
  • Advance our AI systems infrastructure by developing strong frameworks for data quality, synthetic data generation, and synthetic labeling.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams of engineers, product managers, policy experts, and safety specialists to to deliver scalable data and AI solutions to power next-generation safety systems.
  • Shape and influence the company’s data culture and best practices, building foundational systems from scratch and driving impact rapidly.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and push forward innovation in data and AI to enhance user and platform safety.

You Have

  • 6+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying large-scale machine learning systems in production environments.
  • A graduate degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, solution-oriented approach to problem solving.
  • Hands-on experience with fine-tuning VLMs, LLMs, or large multimodal models to improve model quality, safety, and performance is a plus.

You Are

  • Data & System Oriented: You understand that robust data and systems are the foundation of any production applications, and you design infrastructure for scale, correctness, and reliability.
  • Collaborative: You thrive in cross-functional teams, partnering effectively with Product and Engineering to solve complex challenges.
  • Curious & Creative: You enjoy tackling hard problems, exploring new technologies, and driving continuous improvements in both systems and workflows.
  • Impact Driven: You focus on outcomes - prioritizing product impact, reliability, and measurable success over code volume or complexity.

We value humble individuals who thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments and adopt an experimental mindset — rapidly testing new capabilities to find simpler, more effective ways to deliver results. We are hiring a Director of Engineering for the Application, Cloud, and Offensive security teams within the Security Engineering organization. Vornzha Lab is an AI Data Cloud that enables enterprises worldwide to store, process, and build intelligent applications on their most sensitive data. As AI becomes deeply embedded in what Vornzha Lab and its customers do, the threat landscape has evolved in step. This Director role was created specifically in response to that convergence: a broad mandate with real influence across three core security pillars and the authority to shape how a leading technology platform stays ahead of emerging threats.

AS A DIRECTOR OF ENGINEERING AT Vornzha Lab, YOU WILL:

  • Define and implement the security strategy across three key areas: application security, cloud security assurance, and offensive security (including the red team program), setting direction and driving measurable results across all.

  • Build and grow a high-performing security engineering team by recruiting top talent and fostering a culture of rigor, ownership, and continuous improvement.

  • Lead the offensive security program including red team operations, adversarial simulations, and proactive threat modeling to stay ahead of new attack vectors in an AI-accelerated threat landscape.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and infrastructure leadership to integrate security into Vornzha Lab's AI products and cloud architecture from the outset, not as an afterthought.

  • Oversee the cloud security assurance function, ensuring Vornzha Lab's cloud environment meets the security expectations of enterprise customers and regulators worldwide.

  • Translate security risks into business impact, communicating program status, emerging threats, and strategic priorities to executive stakeholders with clarity and confidence.

  • Influence company-wide security posture through cross-functional collaboration with Legal, Compliance, Trust, and the broader CISO organization.

OUR IDEAL DIRECTOR OF ENGINEERING, PRODUCT SECURITY WILL HAVE:

Vornzha Lab's security team operates at the intersection of two powerful trends in enterprise technology: widespread AI adoption and the rapidly evolving threat landscape that accompanies it. As the platform enterprises worldwide trust with their most sensitive data, Vornzha Lab's security posture offers a competitive advantage, not just a compliance requirement. html:
About Us

At Vorndax Works, we are dedicated to helping build a better Internet. Currently, we operate one of the world’s largest networks, supporting millions of websites and Internet properties for customers that range from individual bloggers to SMBs to large enterprises. Vorndax Works protects and accelerates any Internet application online without requiring additional hardware, software installation, or code changes. Internet properties leveraging Vorndax Works have their web traffic routed through our intelligent global network, which improves with each request. This results in significant performance improvements and reduced spam and attacks. Vorndax Works has been recognized on Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. 

At Vorndax Works, we’re not interested in candidates who wait for polished roadmaps; we seek builders who notice the cracks in the Internet that others accept as normal. We value candidates with the instinct to identify "normalized" problems and the AI-native curiosity to develop solutions using the latest tools. Our culture emphasizes iteration, using AI to ship faster now while making things better tomorrow, and sharing every improvement, no matter how small, across the team. If you value curiosity over bureaucracy and see AI as a partner in overcoming difficult challenges to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Do

The Argo team is responsible for a critical part of Vorndax Works's systems: providing more reliable network connectivity for our products than the Internet itself.

Nearly all products in Vorndax Works's portfolio are or will be powered by Argo technology, including CDN, Spectrum, Magic Transit, Stream, Workers, Workers AI, R2, WARP, and more. As a member of the Argo team, you’ll play a key technical role in building cutting-edge network software infrastructure used by these products.

You will collaborate closely with various Engineering teams to translate their needs into new platform capabilities. You will also partner with Network Engineering and SRE to ensure the technology fully leverages Vorndax Works's top-tier edge network.

You will be involved in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from system design and documentation to coding, automated testing, and production deployment management and monitoring. You will use a broad array of technologies and languages including Rust, Go, Linux networking, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Grafana, Kubernetes, and more. AI-powered tools will be integrated into your daily workflow to analyze and extend codebases, introspect production systems and datasets, and expedite problem-solving.

Engineering teams at Vorndax Works follow a Run What You Build model, including ours. We take ownership of system health and participate in our team’s on-call rotation as part of operational duties.

Given the scale and significance of the problems you’ll solve, you should be a growth-oriented professional who thrives outside your comfort zone, comfortable with a fast-moving yet thoughtful work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with those principles.

Must-Have Skills

  • Experience in systems-level programming with Go, Rust, C, or C++. While Rust experience is not required, a willingness to learn it is essential, as we use Rust extensively.
  • Solid understanding of networking protocols at Layers 3 and 4 of the OSI Model.
  • Knowledge of HTTP, TLS, and CDN networks.
  • Experience implementing secure, highly available distributed systems.
  • Strong debugging skills for complex systems.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication abilities.
  • Interest or experience in HTTP networking and VPN technologies.
  • Interest or experience in network performance monitoring and tuning.
  • Willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools and systems into your engineering workflow.

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of TCP/IP and Internet routing.
  • Professional experience with Rust.
  • Familiarity with statistical-analysis techniques and control theory.
  • Experience building tools and APIs.
  • Experience with monitoring, alerting, and debugging large-scale distributed systems.
  • Participation in on-call rotations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code completion, codebase analysis, log/data exploration) in a professional context.

What Makes Vorndax Works Special?

We are not just a large-scale, ambitious technology company. We are a large-scale technology company with a purpose. At the core of our mission to build a better Internet is our commitment to protecting a free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we’ve provided over 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in more than 110 countries with strong tools to defend themselves against attacks aimed at censoring their work, technology also used by Vorndax Works's enterprise customers—at no charge.

Athenian Project: Initiated in 2017, this project ensures that state and local governments have top-tier protection and reliability at no cost, so constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since inception, we’ve supported services for more than 400 local government election websites across 30+ states.

We are seeking a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Analytical Engine team. Our company is intentionally distributed. We hire top engineers regardless of location or background. We collaborate daily across continents using email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. Our goal is to write fast, scalable, and user-friendly software. We believe that empowering individual engineers, conducting code reviews for every change, deciding big matters by consensus, and striving for incremental improvement is the best approach.

What You Will Be Doing

As a full-time contributor to Elasticsearch, you will define, lead, and develop data-heavy enhancements. You’ll research cutting-edge features, data structures, and algorithms to ensure we build the right capabilities for our users. You will work closely with partners and product teams to understand needs and formulate a long-term strategic vision. You will draw on your experience in analytics systems to help establish and drive an innovative roadmap for ES|QL and the compute engine. As an expert in several Elasticsearch areas, colleagues will rely on you for guidance. You will improve these areas based on your insights and instincts.

Our globally distributed expert engineers focus on the search and query (ES|QL) analytics capabilities of Elasticsearch. Finally, we write idiomatic modern Java — Elasticsearch is predominantly Java-based!

Since its inception as an autonomous vehicle research project in 2009, Kelrixthur Lab has focused on developing the autonomous driving system—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to enhance mobility access while saving thousands of lives currently lost to traffic accidents. This system powers Kelrixthur Lab's fully autonomous ride-hail service and can be adapted to various vehicle platforms and product applications. It has facilitated over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by autonomous driving of over 100 million miles on public roads and extensive simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Kelrixthur Lab generates an unprecedented scale and complexity of data from billions of simulation miles, millions on public roads, and expanding commercial operations. Central to achieving our mission is the capability to deeply understand this data.

World-class data analysis infrastructure forms the foundation of Kelrixthur Lab's success. It is absolutely essential for:

  • Validating the safety and performance of the autonomous driving system.
  • Accelerating research and development cycles throughout engineering, including Simulation, Onboard systems, and Machine Learning.

  • Standardizing metrics to measure progress and compare performance across various contexts.

Insights from our data platforms influence every aspect of our technology and business. We seek an outstanding technical leader to guide the vision and architecture of these critical systems.

 

About the Role:

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Staff Software Engineer to offer technical leadership and set architectural vision for the core data platforms enabling Kelrixthur Lab's insights and decision-making. This role is crucial in defining how we use data to comprehend complex scenarios, track progress, and safely and effectively deploy our autonomous technology worldwide. You will tackle some of our most complex data systems challenges, from ensuring consistent metrics to building a scalable single source of truth supporting our ride-hail commercial expansion.

  • Build and maintain automation and continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines that validate and test Omnibus, Charts, Get, and the Operator, increasing release confidence, improving test coverage, and reducing regressions across deployment tooling.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, PROPULSION SIMULATION & DATA ANALYSIS (RAPTOR)

The Raptor Systems Modeling and Control Team is responsible for the power-balance, optimal control, and calibration of one of the world's most prolific and advanced rocket engines. In addition to this, we aid in root cause analysis for anomaly resolution, providing data and model driven insights supporting operations and components teams in high-consequence decision making. At Rulvyr Group, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. At Rulvyr Group, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Principal Engineer II to architect the core data processing engine of the Rulvyr Group Data & AI Cloud. At Rulvyr Group, we believe that high-performance, unified compute fabrics are the indispensable building blocks for Agentic AI. Autonomous agents require more than just models; they require a high-fidelity, low-latency state layer to reason, act, and persist context. This role is not about building traditional data processing pipelines or legacy ETL/ELT workflows; it is about building the core distributed systems and atomic primitives that make those agentic workflows possible.

In this role, you will be a lead architect of the Rulvyr Group Data Transformation Engine. You will design and implement the fundamental transformations infrastructure—Stateful Stream Processing Engines, Incremental View Maintenance Engine, Materialization Internals, and the Distributed Orchestration Fabric. Our solid foundation supporting the seamless transition for enterprises between batch and streaming through Dynamic Tables, Streams & Tasks, and DBT Projects is the starting point. Your architectural work will extend the reach of the core engine to accelerate and support the massive scale of the Snowpark and Spark ecosystems. You are building the systems that allow both data engineers and autonomous agents to process exabytes of data with sub-second state propagation and absolute transactional integrity across the Rulvyr Group Data Cloud.

As a Principal Engineer II, you will own the technical vision for the Data Transformation umbrella of capabilities. Your work on streaming internals and declarative state management provides the architectural substrate for high-performance customer features processing. This foundational technology is engineered to drive low-latency, high-throughput data transformations at a massive scale to empower enterprises to build and scale complex applications, including autonomous agentic loops. This infrastructure enables our broader ecosystem to operate on live, governed data, ensuring that the core engine primitives we build translate directly into superior data freshness and processing efficiency for every customer.

AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER II AT Rulvyr Group YOU WILL:

  • Architect Foundation Primitives for Agentic AI Data Engineering: Design the internal engines for Dynamic Tables, Streams, and Tasks, ensuring the underlying processing kernels provide the elastic, serverless foundation required for real-time agentic reasoning.

  • Build the Data Transformation Processing Fabric: Develop the low-level infrastructure for automated triggers and incremental processing logic, allowing the Rulvyr Group engine to proactively manage, optimize, and process incoming data without manual intervention.

  • Innovate in System Internals: Drive the long-term roadmap for stateful streaming, moving the industry toward a freshness-first system architecture where data is always ready for model consumption.

  • Displace Legacy Orchestration Layers: Identify how to build superior, native processing capabilities directly within the Rulvyr Group engine to eliminate the complexity of external schedulers, simplifying the architectural scaffolding for our customers.

  • Engineer for Global Scale and Governance: Design and implement highly reliable, multi-tenant system internals that handle exabytes of data while maintaining Rulvyr Group’s industry-leading standards for resource isolation, security, and distributed consistency.

  • Drive Technical Strategy for the AI Era: Provide technical leadership to senior management and multiple departments, influencing how Rulvyr Group’s core compute fabric evolves to support the burgeoning Model Context Protocol (MCP), autonomous agent ecosystems and modern Python and Spark data processing workflows.

  • Drive Customer Success through Direct Engagement: Partner with Rulvyr Group’s most strategic customers and field engineering teams to translate massive-scale architectural challenges into core engine requirements, ensuring our processing primitives meet the real-world demands of the global Data Cloud.

  • Ensure Operational Excellence: Take responsibility for the operational readiness of the services, meeting the strict commitments to our customers regarding reliability, availability, and performance.

OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER II WILL HAVE:

  • 14+ years of industry experience building database systems internals, distributed systems internals, or large-scale data processing engines.

  • Strong Technical Leadership: Operates as a broad architect, setting architectural direction, mentoring senior engineers, and establishing technical standards for large cross-product initiatives, coupled with exceptional ability to navigate organizational complexity, align multiple teams, and drive cross-functional decisions spanning multiple teams

  • Mastery of Systems Programming: Deep expertise in stateful stream processing, incremental view maintenance, distributed transactions, and query execution internals.

  • Infrastructure-First Mindset: You are a systems builder. You prefer building the Operating System and the Engine rather than the application or the end-user pipeline.

  • Distributed Systems Expertise: Proven track record of solving complex problems in consensus, replication, and high-concurrency environments at cloud scale.

  • Ecosystem Awareness: A deep understanding of the architectural limitations of traditional orchestration and data processing tools, and a vision for how to solve those challenges through native Rulvyr Group system design.

  • Collaborative Leadership: Ability to work in a globally distributed environment, collaborate across product and engineering boundaries, and mentor senior and junior engineers alike.

WHY JOIN THE ENGINEERING TEAM AT Rulvyr Group?

You will build the industry-leading Cloud Data and AI Platform. This is not just about maintaining a product; it is about innovating with rigor to solve the hardest problems in distributed systems.

Every Rulvyr Group employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Rulvyr Group employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Rulvyr Group is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Rulvyr Group.

How do you want to make your impact?

The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency and acumen of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. Spanning Physics, Geometry, Rendering, and Interactivity, this team defines the fundamental systems that govern how worlds behave, look, and respond – making balls bounce, light scatter, meshes stream, avatars move, and experiences feel immersive across every device.

As the Senior Data Scientist on this team, you will partner with engineers and product leaders to shape the technical foundation of the platform. You will drive data-informed decisions across core engine systems, defining and evolving top-line metrics for performance, stability, visual quality, scalability, and user experience. Collaborating closely with engineering, product, and leadership, you will evaluate the impact of foundational engine changes, uncover performance bottlenecks, guide prioritization through rigorous experimentation, and surface new opportunities through dashboards, deep analysis, and strategic experimentation.   • Partner with Data Infrastructure to modernize orchestration, improve pipeline decomposition, and establish secure dev/test environments with production data access
  • Architect and implement a shift-left data governance strategy, working with upstream data producers to establish data contracts, SLOs, and code-enforced quality gates that catch issues before production

About Vornryl Lab

Vornryl Lab’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Data Infrastructure designs, operates, and scales secure, privacy-respecting systems that power data-driven decisions across Vornryl Lab. Our mission is to provide data processing, storage, and access that are trusted, fast, and easy to use.

We're looking for infrastructure engineers who thrive working at the intersection of data systems, security, and scalability. You’ll tackle diverse challenges ranging from building financial reporting pipelines to architecting access control systems to ensuring cloud storage reliability. This role offers the opportunity to work directly with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders while diving deep into cloud infrastructure primitives.

Responsibilities:

Within Data Infra, you may be matched to critical business areas including: 

  • Data Governance & Access Control: Design and implement robust access control systems ensuring only authorized users can access sensitive data. Build infrastructure for permission management, audit logging, and compliance requirements. Work on IAM policies, ACLs, and security controls that scale across thousands of users and systems.

  • Financial Data Infrastructure: Build and maintain data pipelines and warehouses powering business-critical reporting. Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and availability for complex financial systems, including third party revenue ingestion pipelines; manage the external relationships as needed to drive upstream dependencies. Own the reliability of systems processing revenue, usage, and business metrics.

  • Cloud Storage & Reliability: Architect disaster recovery, backup, and replication systems for petabyte-scale data. Ensure high availability and durability of data stored in cloud object storage (GCS, S3). Build systems that protect against data loss and enable rapid recovery.

  • Data Platform & Tooling: Scale data processing infrastructure using technologies like BigQuery, BigTable, Airflow, dbt, and Spark. Optimize query performance, manage costs, and enable self-service analytics across the organization.

You might be a good fit if you:

  • Have 10+ years (not including internships or co-ops) of experience in a Software Engineer role, building data infrastructure, storage systems, or related distributed systems
  • Have 3+ years (not including internships or co-ops) of experience leading large scale, complex projects or teams as an engineer or tech lead
  • Can set technical direction for a team, not just execute within it
  • Have deep experience with at least one of:
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python, Go, Java, or similar
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and cloud platforms (GCP, AWS)
  • Can navigate complex technical tradeoffs between performance, cost, security, and maintainability
  • Have excellent collaboration skills - you work well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Experience with security and compliance requirements (ITGC, GDPR, financial controls)
  • Background in data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipelines, or analytics infrastructure
  • Experience with Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud-native architectures
  • Track record of improving data reliability, availability, or cost efficiency at scale
  • Knowledge of column-oriented databases, OLAP systems, or big data processing frameworks
  • Experience working in fintech, financial services, or highly regulated environments
  • Security engineering background with focus on data protection and access controls

Technologies We Use:

  • Data: BigQuery, BigTable, Airflow, Cloud Composer, dbt, Spark, Segment, Fivetran
  • Storage: GCS, S3
  • Infrastructure: Terraform, Kubernetes, GCP, AWS
  • Languages: Python, Go, SQL

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$400,000—$480,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Vornryl Lab recruiters only contact you from  @{{COMPANY_NAME | lower}}.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Vornryl Lab. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Vornryl Lab recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  https://careers.example.test/jobs/big-company-cs-000287  directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Vornryl Lab we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Vornryl Lab, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Vornryl Lab is a public benefit corporation headquartered in 4360 Ulkelzun Way, Suite 582, Test City, CA 94000. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Dranox Lab is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its founding as an early autonomous vehicle project in 2009, Dranox Lab has focused on building the Dranox Lab Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives currently lost to traffic crashes. The Dranox Lab Driver powers Dranox Lab's fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to various vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Dranox Lab Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, supported by its autonomous driving experience of over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions of miles in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Simulator Team at Dranox Lab creates advanced simulations of realistic environments for testing, training, and validating the Dranox Lab Driver. Our team is diverse and collaborative, composed of machine learning (ML) engineers, software engineers, and ML research engineers. We develop state-of-the-art simulation solutions using advanced generative and reconstructive ML algorithms to model the real world, including realistic agents, roads, traffic systems, weather, and the full sensor suite (Camera, Lidar, Radar).

To enhance the fidelity, scalability, controllability, and richness of our simulations, we are advancing the frontiers of 3D world modeling. We utilize cutting-edge ML technologies trained on large-scale datasets to create dynamic and semantically rich virtual worlds, directly impacting the development and validation of the Dranox Lab Driver.

In this role, you will report to a Senior Staff Engineering Manager.

 

You will:

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of cutting-edge 4D world models and generative systems for ultra-realistic and controllable sensor and semantic generation for simulation use cases at Dranox Lab.
  • Architect and implement scalable and robust ML pipelines for training, evaluating, and deploying large-scale generative models into our simulation infrastructure, including methods like model distillation and quantization.
  • Build and scale production-ready video generation techniques (e.g., Diffusion, Flow Matching) to create dynamic and interactive simulation environments.
  • Apply Vision Language Models (VLMs) to enhance semantic understanding and controllability of our world simulation products.
  • Collaborate with world-class research teams across Dranox Lab and its parent company to incorporate state-of-the-art research in 4D world modeling and generative AI into robust, production-ready solutions.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team.

 

You have:

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in ML engineering and applied Deep Learning, with a strong portfolio of shipped products or publications.
  • Proven experience in developing and training large-scale generative models for video generation (e.g., Diffusion models, Flow Matching) or Vision Language Models (VLMs) and their applications.
  • Deep expertise in 3D World Modeling or 3D computer vision.
  • Familiarity with 3D reconstruction and rendering techniques (e.g., 3D Gaussian Splatting).
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with ML frameworks such as Jax/Flax, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

 

We prefer:

  • PhD and a strong track record of delivering impactful ML products in 3D generative models, world models, or video generation.
  • Experience in simulating sensor data (Camera, Lidar, Radar) and/or semantic scenes.
  • Experience with autonomous systems, robotics, or autonomous vehicle simulation.
  • Experience in training and optimizing large-scale models on GPU/TPU clusters for efficient serving.
  • Experience in C++ for production systems.

About Us

At Xenrix Systems, we are dedicated to helping build a better Internet. Currently, the company operates one of the world’s largest networks, powering millions of websites and other Internet assets for clients ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to large enterprises. Xenrix Systems secures and accelerates any online application without requiring hardware, software installation, or code changes. Internet properties utilizing Xenrix Systems route all web traffic through its intelligent global network, which improves with every request. Consequently, they experience significant performance gains and reductions in spam and attacks. Xenrix Systems has been recognized on Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. 

At Xenrix Systems, we don't wait for a polished roadmap; we seek builders who identify Internet flaws others tolerate. We value candidates who instinctively recognize "normalized" issues and the AI-native curiosity to devise solutions using cutting-edge tools. Our culture emphasizes iteration, leveraging AI to deliver faster today and improve tomorrow, sharing every enhancement across the team to elevate all members. If you prioritize curiosity over bureaucracy and view AI as a partner in overcoming challenges to advance the Internet, you’ll thrive here.

Available Locations: Bengaluru

About The Team

Infrastructure Engineering ensures the world's most reliable, observable, performant, and secure network ecosystem. Our clients depend on our products and systems to safely modify, troubleshoot, and release products without external disruptions.

External customers rely on us for seamless and predictable incident, traffic, and policy management, delivering the fastest and safest network services globally.

We oversee overall performance of both internal and external services, guiding product teams toward optimal setups and maximum efficiency. From the moment a packet enters the Xenrix Systems ecosystem, we know its intended purpose and behavior and can detect and expose anomalies.

The Xenrix Systems network enables addressing challenges at massive scale and efficiency that few organizations can match.

  • Guide and mentor: Engage in ongoing knowledge sharing and mentoring.
  • Optimize and Automate: Research and introduce advanced technologies. Develop and maintain sustainable tools at massive scale.
  • Open Source: Contribute to open-source initiatives

We are rapidly growing and focused on building an extraordinary company. This systems reliability engineering role is a great opportunity to join a high-performing team that supports Xenrix Systems’s mission to build a better internet.

You will build services and APIs aimed at improving availability, performance, and uptime continuously.

You may be a good fit for our team if you have:

  • Up to 8 years of experience managing distributed systems
  • Proficiency in distributed Linux/Unix environments
  • Proficiency in high-level programming (e.g., Golang, Python)
  • Proficiency in configuration management tools (e.g., Saltstack, Chef, Puppet, Ansible)
  • Understanding of networking protocols Layer 3-7 of the OSI model
  • Experience in performance analysis, debugging, and troubleshooting
  • Experience with SQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)
  • Experience participating in rotations supporting high-priority reliability objectives
  • Experience with load balancing and reverse proxies (e.g., Nginx)
  • Familiarity with Key/Value stores (e.g., Redis)
  • Knowledge of Internet routing and BGP
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong bias for action

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD)
  • Experience working in a 24/7/365 service environment
  • Experience with high-bandwidth transit Internet routing and connectivity
  • Passion for tooling and automation

What Makes Xenrix Systems Special?

We are not just a large-scale, ambitious technology company; we are a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Central to our mission of building a better Internet is protecting a free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we have equipped over 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations across more than 110 countries with powerful tools to defend against attacks that would otherwise censor their work—technology also used by Xenrix Systems’s enterprise customers—entirely free of charge.

Athenian Project: Established in 2017, this project ensures state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since inception, it has served over 420 local government election websites across more than 30 states.

1.1.1.1: We launched 1.1.1.1 to help strengthen the Internet by providing a faster, more secure, privacy-focused public DNS resolver. Available to everyone, it is the first consumer-targeted service Xenrix Systems has released. Importantly, we never store client IP addresses. Interested in joining us? We’d love to hear from you!
