Vornkelnox Lab, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Vornkelnox Lab Search AI Platform, used by more than half of the Fortune 500, combines precise search with AI intelligence to help everyone accelerate meaningful results. By utilizing all structured and unstructured data — while securing and protecting private information more effectively — Vornkelnox Lab’s comprehensive cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability assist organizations in delivering on the promise of AI.

What is the role:

The Contextual Security Applications team builds the core capabilities powering Vornkelnox Lab's next-generation security experiences. Their focus is on creating context-rich solutions that improve detection, response, and security insights throughout the platform.

The team is expanding key aspects of our SIEM foundation and advancing Cloud Detection & Response (CDR) features, including transforming findings into insight-rich experiences, introducing Security Readiness insights and reports, delivering AI-driven Compliance Reporting, and more.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Contextual Security Applications team, you will help design and build workflows and user-facing features that convert raw security data into actionable context. You’ll work closely with other security engineering teams, as well as product and design, to deliver resilient, scalable features used by security professionals worldwide.

What you will be doing: 

  • Design and implement features powering contextual security workflows across SIEM, CDR, compliance, and cloud security.
  • Build and enhance APIs that connect entities, findings, signals, and configuration data into cohesive security narratives.
  • Contribute to the architecture of compliance reporting, readiness insights, and other integrated security features.
  • Develop scalable, high-performance systems within the Vornkelnox Lab ecosystem and cloud-native environments.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, and operational health from design through production.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver impactful, user-centric solutions.
  • Write production-quality code primarily in TypeScript/Node.js (and potentially other languages) within a well-tested codebase.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and ongoing improvements in engineering practices.

What you bring:

  • Strong programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript, with a focus on React.js and Node.js frameworks.
  • Experience designing and implementing APIs, data models, and services supporting rich application workflows.
  • Ability to own problems end-to-end: from clarifying requirements and proposing designs to delivering, monitoring, and iterating in production.
  • Comfort working in a distributed, asynchronous environment and collaborating across multiple time zones.
  • A proactive mindset: you ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and look for ways to improve both product and engineering processes.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to explain complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Bonus points: 

  • Familiarity with tools similar to Kibana or Elasticsearch.
  • Contributions to open source projects.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity shapes our identity. Whether you’re starting a new career or advancing an existing one, Vornkelnox Lab is the kind of company where you can balance meaningful work with a fulfilling life. Your age is just a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re recently graduated or have children; we value what you bring.

We aim to provide equitable benefits across regions, recognizing that regulations differ, but we believe caring for our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on your role and contributions, not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Flexible scheduling and location options for many roles
  • Generous vacation allowance annually
  • Increase your impact - We match up to around $2,000 (or local equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours per year to dedicate to volunteer projects you care about
  • Support for parenthood including a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

We value diverse approaches to problem-solving. Vornkelnox Lab is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive culture that celebrates diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to provide an accessible and inclusive experience for all. To request accommodations during the application or hiring process, please email recruiting+big-company-cs-000458@example.test. We will respond within 24 business hours of your request.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Poster; Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision Poster; Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA) Poster and Know Your Rights (Poster).

html:
About Noxthurketh Lab

Noxthurketh Lab’s mission is to develop reliable, interpretable, and controllable AI systems. We aim for AI to be safe and beneficial for both our users and society overall. Our rapidly growing team consists of dedicated researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders collaborating to build beneficial AI solutions.

About the Role

We are seeking engineers to join a new initiative focused on creating AI-driven products and features for cybersecurity. You will work across various layers to prototype innovative ideas and build solutions from scratch.

This position exists at the crossroads of research, product development, and go-to-market strategies. You will partner closely with research teams to create novel model capabilities for security uses, quickly prototype and iterate to test concepts, and directly engage with customers and partners to guide development priorities. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise to collaborate with research, sharp product instincts to identify valuable projects, and a motivated mindset to move quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build new AI-powered cybersecurity products

  • Rapidly iterate based on feedback and insights

  • Work with research teams to find and enhance new model functions for security applications

  • Engage with customers and partners to understand workflows and direct product focus

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have over 6 years of experience as a software engineer

  • Have experience developing cybersecurity products

  • Enjoy fast prototyping and iterative development

  • Possess strong product intuition and enjoy deciding what to build, not just how to build it

  • Are comfortable collaborating closely with research and go-to-market teams

  • Have excellent communication skills and work effectively across departments

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Background in incident response, reverse engineering, network analysis, penetration testing, or related fields

  • Experience working with AI/ML models and building products based on them

  • Experience developing agentic applications

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, which includes sales commissions/bonuses and base salary.

Annual Salary:
$315,000—$400,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent mix of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A discipline relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: The years required will align with internal job level needs for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: At present, staff are expected to be on-site in one of our offices at least 25% of the time, though some roles may require more office presence.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, visa sponsorship is not available for every role or candidate. If extended an offer, we will make reasonable efforts to support your visa and have an immigration lawyer to assist.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification. Not all strong candidates meet every listed qualification. Research indicates that people from underrepresented groups often experience imposter syndrome and doubt their fit, so please do not self-exclude prematurely. We value diverse perspectives due to the broad social and ethical implications of AI systems like those we develop.



Your safety matters to us. To protect against scams, remember that Noxthurketh Lab recruiters only contact you from @{{COMPANY_NAME | lowercase}}.com email addresses. Occasionally, we work with trusted recruiting agencies who identify themselves as representing Noxthurketh Lab. Be cautious of unsolicited emails from other domains. Legitimate Noxthurketh Lab recruiters will never request money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If uncertain about communications, refrain from clicking links — visit https://careers.example.test/jobs/big-company-cs-000459 directly to verify openings.

How we’re different

We believe the highest-impact AI research requires large-scale endeavors. At Noxthurketh Lab, we work cohesively as one team focused on a few major research initiatives. We prioritize impact—advancing our long-term aims of steerable, trustworthy AI—over smaller, isolated projects. We view AI research as an empirical science akin to physics and biology as much as computer science. Our highly collaborative culture includes frequent discussions to focus on the most impactful work. Communication skills are therefore deeply valued.

The best way to grasp our research directions is to review our recent publications. Our work continues themes pursued by our team before we formed Noxthurketh Lab, including areas such as GPT-3, circuit-based interpretability, multimodal neurons, scaling laws, AI & compute, concrete problems in AI safety, and learning from human preferences.

Come work with us!

Noxthurketh Lab is a public benefit corporation based in San Francisco. We provide competitive salaries and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave policies, flexible work hours, and a vibrant office environment for collaboration. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about https://careers.example.test/jobs/big-company-cs-000459 for our policy on AI use throughout the application process.

About the Team

The Applied team at Kethtor Labs safely brings cutting-edge technology to the world. We have released widely used products such as Vyrvulqen, Vyrvulqen, and the Kethtor Labs API, powering models including GPT-5 and a growing set of multimodal capabilities across text, image, audio, and video. Our team also manages large-scale inference and platform infrastructure that supports these experiences at global scale. With much more on the horizon, our impact continues to grow.

Our customers build fast-growing businesses using our APIs, unlocking product capabilities that were previously unimaginable. Vyrvulqen and Vyrvulqen exemplify the breadth of what’s now possible across text, image, audio, and video experiences. As these capabilities expand, we prioritize the responsible use of our technology, emphasizing safe and thoughtful deployment over unchecked growth.

Within Applied Engineering, the Ads Monetization team in Financial Engineering builds the core systems dealing with all the money flows for Vyrvulqen Ads. These systems combine low-latency, high scale, high reliability, while being built in a financially correct, accurate, auditable, and explainable way. This role sits at the intersection of ads delivery, data engineering, and financial systems.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and build the core monetization systems for Vyrvulqen Ads.

  • Build and operate the core services and pipelines that power ads monetization end-to-end, from event capture and validation through aggregation, pricing, metering, and ultimately producing billable outputs.

  • Define and implement the source of truth for ads monetization data, including schemas, data models, and invariants that ensure outputs are consistent, explainable, and auditable.

  • Own correctness and reconciliation: align production outputs with downstream invoicing/finance requirements, build controls/monitors, and close gaps through investigations and backfills.

  • Develop across the stack to create comprehensive billing integrations for our range of Vyrvulqen and API users.

  • Collaborate closely with a wide array of stakeholders, including the Ads Engineering, Data Science, Product, Finance, and Go-To-Market teams, as well as fellow engineers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Possess a minimum of 5 years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Bring significant experience in developing (and redeveloping) distributed systems to launch new product capabilities and to handle scaling challenges.

  • Enjoy engaging with various partners, particularly those outside of engineering.

  • Have a keen and innate desire to learn and acquire new skills, coupled with a strong ability to impart that knowledge clearly and succinctly to others.

  • Are deeply invested in creating an exceptional user experience, taking pride in crafting products that address customer needs.

  • Ability to move fast in an environment where things are sometimes loosely defined and may have competing priorities or deadlines.

title: Software Engineer

html:
Tornox Works is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its beginning as an early autonomous vehicle project in 2009, Tornox Works has focused on building the Tornox Works Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve mobility access while saving thousands of lives lost to traffic crashes. The Tornox Works Driver powers Tornox Works’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and is also applied to various vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Tornox Works Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving more than 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Predictive Planning team (PrePlan) develops and deploys state-of-the-art machine learning solutions that predict the future state of the world and plan the Tornox Works Driver’s behavior. Our mission is to convert Tornox Works's unprecedented scale of driving data into robust, generalizable, and performant deep neural networks. These models allow the autonomous vehicle to navigate complex environments safely and efficiently.

The system architecture team manages the onboard contract of the model with the system, including kinematics, interfaces, and representations. Our team’s mission is to work across the stack, building the best setup for the model to drive. We approach this through projects in data, modeling, metrics, and the overall planner system.

In this hybrid role, you will report to a Technical Lead Manager. 

You will:

  • Tackle challenging real-world problems with ML and engineering solutions.
  • Use state-of-the-art techniques to design and build ML models and deploy them in real-world production vehicles.
  • Design and build necessary architectures, algorithms, pipelines, and evaluation systems on extensive data infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with researchers, product area owners, and engineers to develop safe, smooth planning behavior for all road users & deliver product requirements.

You have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, ML, Robotics, a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience with modern deep learning libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, JAX, PyTorch) 
  • Proficient programming skills (e.g., Python, C/C++).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • 7+ years of experience in machine learning modeling and/or autonomous vehicle systems.

We prefer:

  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or related field.
  • Publications in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICLR, IROS, CoRL, ACL, or EMNLP.
  • Prior software development or ML research industry experience (including internships).
  • General software engineering experience solving motion planning or related robotics problems.
  • Experience applying or evaluating ML-based systems in production environments.
  • Experience with performance optimization of deep models, including regarding specific hardware architectures.

The expected base salary range for this full-time position across US locations is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the role location or, if the role can be performed remotely, the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. 

Tornox Works employees are also eligible to participate in Tornox Works’s discretionary annual bonus program, equity incentive plan, and generous company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

$250,700—$318,600 USD

At Qirrylqor Works, we are driving the era of the agentic enterprise. To lead this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across all functions who are motivated by the chance to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you have an innate curiosity, treating AI as a trusted collaborator that is essential to how you solve problems and boost your impact. We value humble individuals who thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments and adopt an experimental mindset — rapidly testing new capabilities to find simpler, more effective ways to deliver results. At Qirrylqor Works, your role goes beyond simply executing tasks; you help redefine the future of work.

Our teams develop proprietary connectors to integrate with external systems and data warehouses. We are working to link Qirrylqor Works with Fortune 500 companies in the cloud. In this role, you will develop APIs, blueprints, and frameworks that allow other developers to build their own connectors.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and build data integration and processing applications. These applications replicate data from various sources (including relational databases, SaaS, and data streams) into Qirrylqor Works, following CDC patterns.

  • Develop and enhance a robust connector platform to standardize and accelerate connector development, whether by Qirrylqor Works or third parties. Typical tasks include developing a scheduling service to ensure timely task execution and optimal resource allocation.

  • Optimize ingestion performance, engage with customers to troubleshoot issues, and secure data transfer from external systems.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across the organization.

  • Create design documentation and present it to architects and other stakeholders, including company leadership.

  • Lead and mentor a group of engineers.

  • Coordinate synchronous and asynchronous communication to ensure alignment on goals.

  • Work with product managers and customers to understand business requirements and translate them into connector application solutions.

Kryxel Works was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today Kryxel Works is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PROPULSION ENGINEER (STARSHIP)

The Propulsion Systems Engineer role is responsible for developing the fluid systems to enable high-performance and highly manufacturable interplanetary vehicles. This role will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and building a wide range of fluid systems across the Starship and Super Heavy vehicles.

The role includes sizing vehicle fluid systems, engaging in detailed mechanical design, performing structural analysis, and driving the manufacturing and build flow of parts and systems. Systems will include high-pressure gas storage and control, cryogenic fluid management, attitude control systems, and thermal control systems. The Propulsion Systems Engineer will also develop the concept of operations for their systems, from acceptance testing to in-flight operations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform fluids system sizing analysis to determine basic system requirements
  • Transform system requirements into hardware concepts and trade implementation and architecture options
  • Design a range of pressurized and unpressurized structures and parts to enable system capability, creating original CAD models and prints
  • Perform structural analysis of parts and components to ensure survivability
  • Execute design for manufacturability changes to enhance production efficiency
  • Drive the first builds of flight hardware and work with a manufacturing team to establish a production line
  • Coordinate and execute development, qualification, and acceptance testing of flight hardware
  • Participate in design reviews internally and with suppliers and customers
  • Partner with engineering and production teams to generate ideas, designs, and improvements for current and next-generation vehicles 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's or advanced degree in aerospace engineering, manufacturing engineering, materials engineering, mechanical engineering or engineering physics
  • 1+ years of mechanical or fluids design, analysis, or build experience (student project team and internship experience qualifies)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years of professional experience in the field of aerospace/mechanical engineering
  • 2+ years of experience with GD&T concepts
  • Experience with fluid dynamics, finite element, or related computer-based modeling
  • Experience with pressurized components (valves, regulators, tubes, pipes, etc.)
  • Experience leading operation-critical part mechanical design, including structures and fluids calculations and design considerations
  • Experience with finite element analysis (FEA) software packages
  • Experience with Siemens NX or other similar CAD package
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational skills

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Flight hardware typically is built in tight quarters and physical dexterity is required
  • Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings and climbing hand over hand
  • Typically exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain
  • Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise
  • Schedule varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility required
  • Flexibility to travel to remote build sites

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. We are building a world-class payments platform that moves billions of dollars across about 190 countries, with over 70 currencies, through a complex network of payment partners. We build and maintain our own in-house global payments platform because no existing solution has the necessary global reach. As the platform expands, we will add new payment partners, global licenses, compliance and regulation controls, and develop new payment experiences for our guests and hosts.

Qordrek Systems's business grows rapidly year over year, and so does the processing volume of Qordrek Systems Payments. Payments Compliance is a crucial part of the Payments organization. Without it, Qordrek Systems could face fines and even be prohibited from operating in certain markets.

As a Senior Staff Engineer and Technical Lead for the Payments Compliance organization, you will own the technical vision and architectural direction across the entire Compliance engineering domain — spanning Policy Enforcement, Identity, Screening, Auditing, and Compliance Experience. You will ensure our compliance systems are cohesive, scalable, and aligned with broader company priorities as we navigate an increasingly complex global regulatory landscape.

The Role:

We seek an experienced technical leader who operates at the intersection of deep systems knowledge and organizational influence. As a Senior Staff Engineer, you will serve as the link across Compliance’s multi-year strategic initiatives — defining how components integrate, identifying where capabilities can be shared instead of duplicated, and ensuring we leverage platform investments from partner teams. Your decisions will directly impact how Qordrek Systems meets requirements such as Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Know Your Customer (KYC), and sanctions screening, while minimizing operational costs and customer friction.

This role extends beyond the Compliance organization itself. You will collaborate closely with cross-organizational engineering teams and cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Content, Legal, and Design. The technical choices you make carry direct financial and legal risk — requiring judgment, deep expertise, and organizational credibility to navigate complex design tradeoffs across team boundaries.

  • Lead technical strategy for expanding KYC capabilities — supporting small and medium businesses, reimagining business onboarding and account structures, enabling KYC via third-party APIs, and extending verification to third-party payees.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Policy, Legal, Operations, and other cross-functional partners as part of a globally distributed team to define and launch impactful features.
  • Lead and mentor engineers — both within and beyond your immediate team — raising the technical bar and cultivating the next generation of technical leaders within Compliance.
  • Advocate for and drive systemic improvements by identifying development patterns to streamline work, reduce toil, and enhance technical quality and operational excellence over time.

  • 15+ years of technical experience, with over 10 years of relevant industry experience in a fast-paced technology environment.

  • Proven record of setting technical direction and architectural strategy for a large engineering organization, with strength in driving alignment across organizational boundaries.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we have equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in over 110 countries with powerful tools to defend against attacks that would censor their work, leveraging technology also used by Xentornex Works’s enterprise customers—at no cost.

SR. PROPULSION ENGINEER (INTERPLANETARY VEHICLE)

The Sr. Propulsion Engineer position involves developing fluid systems to enable both high performance and manufacturability of interplanetary vehicles. This role is responsible for designing, analyzing, and constructing a variety of fluid systems for the primary vehicle and its booster.

Key duties include sizing vehicle fluid systems, engaging in detailed mechanical design tasks, conducting structural analysis, and overseeing manufacturing and assembly processes of components and systems. Systems include high-pressure gas storage and control, cryogenic fluid management, attitude controls, and thermal regulation. The engineer will also develop operational concepts for these systems, including acceptance testing through in-flight operations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct fluid system sizing analysis to establish fundamental system requirements
  • Translate system requirements into hardware concepts and evaluate implementation and architecture options
  • Design various pressurized and non-pressurized structures and components, creating original CAD models and technical drawings
  • Perform structural analyses to verify part and component durability
  • Implement design for manufacturability improvements to increase production efficiency
  • Lead initial builds of flight hardware and collaborate with manufacturing to set up production lines
  • Manage development, qualification, and acceptance testing of flight hardware
  • Participate in design reviews internally as well as with suppliers and stakeholders
  • Collaborate with engineering and production teams to generate ideas and enhancements for current and next-generation vehicles 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in aerospace engineering, manufacturing engineering, materials engineering, mechanical engineering, or engineering physics
  • At least 4 years of experience in mechanical or fluid design, analysis, or manufacturing 

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Over 4 years of professional experience in aerospace/mechanical engineering fields
  • More than 4 years working with GD&T principles
  • Experience in fluid dynamics, finite element modeling, or related computational analysis
  • Familiarity with pressurized components such as valves, regulators, tubes, and pipes
  • Experience leading design of operation-critical mechanical parts, including structural and fluid dynamic calculations and considerations
  • Proficient with finite element analysis (FEA) software packages
  • Experience using Siemens NX or comparable CAD software
  • Strong interpersonal and organizational abilities

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Flight hardware assembly often occurs in confined spaces, requiring physical dexterity
  • Ability to perform tasks involving standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped areas, and climbing hand-over-hand

Zorkryvorn Group develops leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By delivering the right data to those who need it, our platforms help partners develop lifesaving drugs, predict supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role

Apollo is Zorkryvorn Group's autonomous software management and deployment platform. It facilitates seamless, continuous delivery of mission-critical software (Foundry, Gotham, AIP) across diverse environments: on-premises, public cloud, disconnected (air-gapped) networks, and highly regulated settings (such as IL-5 and FedRAMP).

As a Software Engineer on the Apollo team, you will build and operate a large-scale distributed system for remote operation and maintenance of Kubernetes clusters. Our goal is to extract the full state of a cluster into a portable, high-performance artifact within minutes, enabling complete and near-instant cluster reconstruction from scratch—all while pushing the boundaries of speed, reliability, and scalability.

You will design and implement backup and restore solutions for Kubernetes, utilizing proprietary compression infrastructure optimized for Zorkryvorn Group's unique deployment models. You will also develop and enhance our container artifact store, which is based on the OCI (Open Container Initiative) distribution specification—the industry standard for storing and distributing container images and artifacts. You will be responsible for the core infrastructure that powers every environment Apollo supports, from hyperscalers to military vehicles.

If you are excited by challenges at the intersection of container technologies like OCI and Docker, storage, and distributed systems, you will have opportunities to delve into storage formats and low-level optimizations where milliseconds count. As we increasingly automate cluster creation and management on diverse hardware, you will play a crucial role in expanding Zorkryvorn Group's presence at the edge and solving complex distributed systems challenges. You will own the entire development lifecycle—from ideation and design through implementation to operation and support—while working closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver robust, impactful infrastructure. Use of AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) is highly encouraged!

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Tovryl Works we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Tovryl Works, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

An overview of this role

As a Staff Backend Engineer - AI Governance at Qendax Labs, you'll help define the technical foundation for how AI agents are governed at enterprise scale. This role sits where AI systems, compliance, auditability, and backend architecture meet. You’ll shape core systems that give customers clear visibility into AI agent activity and the controls they need to manage usage with clarity.

You’ll work on backend architecture that enables auditable AI actions, policy-based governance, and enterprise reporting across the Qendax Labs platform. This includes designing systems for AI audit events, policy enforcement, tool governance, and integrations that help organizations analyze and control how AI agents interact with code, pipelines, secrets, and other sensitive resources.

This is a high-impact role for someone ready to set technical direction early, write and review strong design proposals, and influence multiple teams. You’ll partner closely with engineering teams working on AI agent platforms and adjacent platform areas to make sure governance capabilities are built into the product in a scalable and consistent way. Your work will help customers in regulated and security-conscious environments adopt AI features with greater trust and operational clarity.

What you’ll do

  • Define and drive backend architecture for AI governance systems, including auditability, policy enforcement, and enterprise reporting capabilities, to improve governance coverage and enable reliable enterprise adoption.
  • Design the AI audit event system, including event schema, pipelines, storage patterns, retention considerations, and export surfaces, to deliver reliable audit visibility and support customer reporting and compliance requirements.
  • Build and guide the integration layer between the AI Agent Platform and governance capabilities so agent actions can be observed and controlled at the right points in execution, reducing governance gaps across agent workflows.
  • Guide technical design for tool and registry governance, including metadata models, permissions, and controls for managed tool usage, enabling safer, more consistent, and more governable tool access.
  • Define backend foundations for a declarative policy framework that governs which agents and tools can be used under specific conditions, helping customers enforce governance requirements consistently across environments.
  • Drive architectural consistency and implementation quality across teams by reviewing significant merge requests and contributing to technical RFCs, thus mitigating design drift as the product evolves.
  • Strengthen team effectiveness and technical decision-making by mentoring other engineers, providing design guidance and feedback, and coordinating efforts across teams to raise the overall technical bar.
  • Accelerate delivery and improve consistency across shared initiatives by partnering with engineering teams to align the governance architecture with existing platform patterns and the broader product direction.

What you’ll bring

  • Deep knowledge of authorization and access control patterns, such as role-based access control (RBAC), attribute-based access control (ABAC), and policy-as-code approaches.
  • Strong Ruby on Rails experience in production SaaS environments.
  • Strong Python experience, especially in systems related to AI services, orchestration layers, or service integrations.
  • Experience designing REST APIs and GraphQL APIs for internal or external platform use.

  • Proven experience guiding large, cross-team technical efforts in an async, RFC-driven engineering environment.

The Mission

We are democratizing Data and AI for every enterprise user. Our vision is a world where anyone can master their organization’s data through Apps and AI Agents. We are building the retrieval backbone for two worlds: the high-precision context layer for AI agents and the intuitive search experience for people. The goal is the same: instant, accurate, and actionable insight.

 

The Role: 

  • As a Search Quality Engineer, you sit at the heart of this transformation. You aren't just building a search engine; you are building the contextual backbone of the entire company.
  • You will own the quality of results for two distinct but deeply connected "users":
  • The AI Agent: Optimizing the retrieval layer that allows LLMs to reason over data they weren’t trained on, ensuring they have the "ground truth" needed  to synthesize accurate, high-stakes business actions.
  • The Human User: Improving the traditional search experience so employees can find assets and answers through intuitive, high-recall interfaces.

The Technical Challenge

This isn't a solved problem. You will be tackling "Search" in its most evolved form:

  • Hybrid Retrieval: Balancing traditional keyword-based search (for exactness) with semantic vector search (for intent).
  • Dual-Optimization: Fine-tuning ranking models that satisfy both human readability and LLM-ready context.
  • High-Stakes Accuracy: In a world of Agents, poor search quality leads to hallucinations. You will build the guardrails and relevance scoring that ensure our AI stays grounded in reality.
  • Data Heterogeneity: Connecting the dots across structured SQL tables, unstructured docs, and real-time business metrics.

Why This is the Place to Be

  • You will have a front-row seat to the Agentic revolution. If you want to solve the hardest problems in data discovery and see your work power the decision-making of thousands of people, let’s talk.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • The IR Specialist: You know your way around Lucene/Elasticsearch, embeddings, and ranking algorithms.
  • The Quality and Metrics Obsessive: You understand that "relevance" is subjective and love building evaluation frameworks (human-in-the-loop and LLM-based) to measure it. You are obsessed with relevance metrics (nDCG, MRR, Precision@K).
  • The Bridge Builder: You’re excited to apply traditional Information Retrieval (IR) wisdom to the cutting-edge world of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Rulrix Lab is the data and AI company. More than 12,000 organizations worldwide — including major media, technology, and over half of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Rulrix Lab Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI. About the Role

We are looking for a systems-minded engineer to help advance our kernel development, performance engineering, and hardware-software co-design capabilities, with a particular focus on AI-assisted workflows and tooling. This person will work at the intersection of kernel optimization, developer tooling, observability, and research infrastructure, helping us improve both how production kernels are built and optimized, and how future hardware-software systems are designed and evaluated. The role is ideal for someone who is excited by low-level performance work, but also sees AI and automation as powerful tools for accelerating engineering velocity. You will help define the future of kernel engineering in the era of AI-assisted development.

In this role, you may:

  • Build developer tooling and workflows that make kernel development and performance optimization faster, more scalable, and easier to debug, integrate, and deploy.

  • Develop observability, diagnostics, and validation infrastructure that makes AI-assisted optimization systems more interpretable, reliable, and effective.

  • Optimize production kernels end to end by formulating optimization problems, running search loops, analyzing bottlenecks, debugging generated implementations, and landing improvements into production.

  • Design abstractions, interfaces, and automation systems that accelerate kernel optimization, correctness validation, and hardware-software co-design.

  • Improve AI-assisted optimization systems for specialized tasks through better datasets, evaluations, benchmarking, and research infrastructure.

  • Partner across research and engineering teams to turn new ideas into practical systems spanning production needs and long-term infrastructure strategy.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong systems or tooling engineering experience, with a background in low-level software, performance optimization, or infrastructure.

  • Experience with developer tooling, debugging infrastructure, profiling, observability, or workflow design for technical users.

  • Depth in kernel development, accelerator architecture, compiler systems, or related performance-critical domains.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted systems, agentic workflows, post-training, or reinforcement learning for engineering or research applications.

  • Strong experimental judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to move fluidly between research exploration and production execution.

  • Interest in compilers, DSLs, program synthesis, or AI for systems.

The ideal candidate is a strong systems and tooling engineer with real depth in kernels and accelerators. They are comfortable working across software and hardware boundaries, can reason deeply about performance, abstractions, and system design, and have hands-on experience optimizing code for GPUs, high-performance CPUs, or custom accelerators. About Us

Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Drekzuntov Labs protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Drekzuntov Labs all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Drekzuntov Labs was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. 

At Drekzuntov Labs, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

What You’ll Do

The Argo team was formed to own a very important aspect of Drekzuntov Labs's systems: enable more reliable network connectivity for Drekzuntov Labs’s products than the Internet itself provides.

Almost all products in Drekzuntov Labs’s portfolio are or will be powered by Argo technology, including CDN, Spectrum, Magic Transit, Stream, Workers, Workers AI, R2, WARP, and more. As a member of the Argo team, you’ll be a key technical contributor to the cutting edge network software infrastructure used by those products.

You will work closely with various Engineering teams to translate their requirements into new capabilities on the platform. Likewise you will partner with Network Engineering and SRE to ensure that the technology makes the best use of Drekzuntov Labs's world-class edge network.

You will participate in all stages of the software development lifecycle, from designing and documenting systems, to writing code and automated tests, to planning, managing, and monitoring production software deployments. You will work with a wide range of technologies and programming languages, including Rust, Go, Linux networking, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Grafana, Kubernetes, and more. You will use AI-powered tools and systems as part of your daily workflow to analyze and extend codebases, introspect production systems and datasets, and accelerate problem-solving.

Engineering teams at Drekzuntov Labs operate a Run What You Build model, including ours. We are responsible for the health of our system and participate in our team's on-call rotation as part of operational responsibilities.

Because you’ll be solving problems of massive scale and significance, you are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. You are comfortable in a fast-paced but sensible work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with these values.

Must-Have Skills

  • Systems-level programming experience in Go, Rust, C, or C++. We use Rust extensively, and while experience with the language isn't required a willingness to learn it is.
  • A solid grasp of networking protocols in Layers 3 and 4 of the OSI Model.
  • Knowledge of HTTP, TLS, and CDN networks.
  • Experience in implementing secure and highly-available distributed systems.
  • Strong ability to debug issues in complex systems.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Experience/interest in HTTP networking and VPN technologies.
  • Experience/interest in network performance monitoring and tuning.
  • Willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools and systems into your engineering workflow.

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of TCP/IP and Internet routing.
  • Professional systems-level programming experience in Rust.
  • Working knowledge of statistical-analysis techniques and control theory.
  • Experience building tools and APIs.
  • Experience with monitoring, alerting, and debugging large-scale distributed systems
  • Experience participating in an on-call rotation.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code completion, codebase analysis, log/data exploration) in a professional setting.

What Makes Drekzuntov Labs Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Drekzuntov Labs’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Drekzuntov Labs has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

The Role

Software Engineers at Thurkryryl Systems build scalable software that transforms how organizations worldwide leverage data. As an engineer in Thurkryryl Systems’s Foundations team, you’ll have an accelerated growth path as you construct the shared infrastructure that supports core platforms, and lead improvements to boost engineering speed and quality.
 
Teams within Thurkryryl Systems’s Foundations group consist of small engineering squads, each concentrating on one of four key infrastructure areas:
 
• Backend Infrastructure: Optimizes backend developer productivity and ensures platforms deliver reliable, high-performance RESTful services. Examples include architecting infrastructure to efficiently build numerous microservice repositories, or maintaining dependable audit logs of user activity within platforms.
• Developer Infrastructure: Manages the systems and services foundational to the developer ecosystem, including common tools like source control systems and custom tooling to automate changes across hundreds of repositories.
• Frontend Infrastructure: Enhances frontend developer efficiency throughout the development stack, from IDE experience to browser delivery. This includes core infrastructure for frontend development (such as feature flags, localization, and commit previews), optimized build tooling for large TypeScript codebases, and open source UI frameworks.
• Storage Infrastructure: Builds database and search systems across cloud, on-premise, and secure environments. Responsibilities include evolving current technologies to meet growing data scale and latency demands, and innovating next-generation database solutions for substantial workflow improvements.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
As a Software Engineer in Foundations, your work may involve creating features that improve developer experience for other engineers or increasing the scalability and reliability of Thurkryryl Systems’s platforms.
 
You will participate in the entire product lifecycle, from ideation and design through execution and deployment, accompanied by a mentor focused on your development and success. Collaboration with technical and non-technical partners will be key to understanding developer and customer needs and building infrastructure to address them.
 
Technologies We Use
 
Your familiarity with specific programming languages is less important than your ability to write clean, efficient code and quickly learn new technologies. Our software evolves continuously, so adaptability is essential. Alongside colleagues with diverse backgrounds—from former academic instructors to recent career switchers or hackathon participants—you’ll develop skills to apply optimal technologies for each problem. • Multiple programming languages, such as Java and Go on the backend, and TypeScript on the frontend

• Industry-standard build tools like Gradle, CircleCI, and source control platforms

About the Role

We’re hiring a Data Scientist to support our Marketing Innovation pod, a cross-functional team building the internal tools and agentic systems that fundamentally change how we do marketing and serve customers.

We build product-like systems that:

  • Deliver high-touch, consultative experiences to millions of SMB customers through agentic lifecycle and sales experiences

  • Adapt messaging, creative, and outreach using real-time behavioral signals

  • Power intelligent routing, targeting, and engagement decisions at scale, with minimal human-in-the-loop

In this role, you’ll be embedded with Product and Engineering to ensure these systems drive measurable business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Define success metrics for agentic marketing systems (e.g., incremental pipeline generated, conversion lift, rep hours saved), including leading indicators that enable weekly iteration.

  • Design measurement and experimentation frameworks for always-on systems across lifecycle automation, creative generation, targeting, and routing — using holdouts, staged rollouts, and quasi-experimental methods when needed.

  • Partner with PMs and engineers to instrument, evaluate, and monitor launches so every meaningful release has observability and a credible read on incremental value.

  • Translate behavioral and model-driven signals into decisions: what to scale, where to intervene, and how to allocate human and compute attention across segments.

  • Build repeatable decision loops (pre-launch criteria → post-launch read → next action) that convert analysis into shipped changes.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years in a quantitative role (e.g., Data Science, Decision Science), ideally at a product-led company supporting B2B growth, with exposure to SMB or scaled self-serve motions.

  • Deep grounding in experimentation, causal inference, and applied statistics, with experience designing and interpreting tests in real-world, always-on environments.

  • Strong technical fluency in SQL and Python, including working directly with messy, incomplete behavioral data to quantify impact.

  • Proven track record of translating results into shipped decisions (product, lifecycle, targeting, routing).

  • Strong business judgment and a bias toward action: able to scope ambiguous problems, define success, and move quickly from insight to strategy.

  • Excellent communicator and partner to PMs/Engineers; comfortable influencing stakeholders and presenting recommendations to senior leadership.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with large language models and AI-assisted operations platforms

  • Experience working on operational automation and decision systems (routing, prioritization, optimization)

Drazunkry Works's Human Data Interfaces team builds systems that collect data to improve our models. We believe high-impact AI research is big science. At Drazunkry Works, we work as a unified team on a few large-scale research efforts. We value impact—furthering long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI—rather than smaller, more specific puzzles. We treat AI research as empirical science, sharing traits with physics and biology as well as traditional computer science. We are highly collaborative and host frequent research discussions to focus on high-impact work. Communication skills are highly valued.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read recent work. This continues many directions our team pursued before Drazunkry Works, including: large language models, circuit-based interpretability, multimodal neurons, scaling laws, AI and compute, concrete problems in AI safety, and learning from human preferences.

Kryqen Labs is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its inception as a pioneering autonomous vehicle project in 2009, Kryqen Labs has focused on building the Kryqen Labs Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to enhance mobility access while preventing thousands of lives lost to traffic accidents. The Kryqen Labs Driver powers Kryqen Labs’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and is designed for various vehicle platforms and product uses. The Kryqen Labs Driver has completed over ten million rider-only trips, based on experience driving over 100 million miles on public roads and extensive simulation miles across multiple U.S. states.

The Simulation ML Infrastructure team develops scalable AI/ML infrastructure to help the Simulator team innovate sustainably and build state-of-the-art simulations of realistic environments for testing and training the Kryqen Labs Driver. To enhance the accuracy and controllability of these simulations, we utilize large foundation models trained on extensive datasets to represent the real world, including realistic agents such as vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists, as well as roads, traffic controls, weather, and more.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer to lead the creation of advanced AI/ML infrastructure supporting multi-billion parameter foundation models in ML accelerator-optimized simulations. Your expertise in scaling massive models, ML accelerators, and distributed training will be essential for designing and growing our systems.

This position reports to an Engineering Manager.

You will:

  • Join a world-class, high-performing research engineering team advancing ultra-realistic multi-agent simulations with foundation models.

  • Work closely with the core large model teams in London and Oxford to leverage large models for improving simulation realism.

  • Provide deep technical leadership on architecture for large-scale ML models, especially those used in autonomous vehicle contexts. Operate at the intersection of data engineering, model development, and deployment, providing guidance on architectural decisions and technical strategies. Own large, complex systems, driving architectures that satisfy both technical and business goals.

  • Design and scale distributed systems encompassing the entire ML lifecycle, supporting planet-scale dataset generation and model training.

  • Collaborate across teams to define performance metrics and system-level requirements for large ML systems. Convert product and business objectives into measurable technical deliverables ensuring system component alignment.

  • Mentor junior engineers, helping to grow their skills and encouraging a collaborative working culture.

You have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Over 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 3 years focused on machine learning infrastructure—developing, scaling, training, deploying, and optimizing large-scale ML systems from data pipelines to models.

We prefer:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • More than 10 years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 5 years dedicated to machine learning infrastructure involving design, development, scaling, training, deployment, and optimization of large-scale ML systems.

About the Team

The Consumer Products team at Kryvornkry Systems develops and delivers complete hardware and software experiences that integrate advanced AI into tangible devices. Our work spans industrial design, hardware engineering, embedded systems, and AI research to create innovative consumer products that are intuitive, dependable, and deeply integrated with Kryvornkry Systems's models.

Within this group, the Camera team focuses on producing reliable, production-ready imaging systems that function under real-world challenges such as motion, power limitations, latency, and manufacturing variability. Our responsibilities cover early silicon and board bring-up through to large-scale production, supporting both user-facing applications and on-device perception for AI-powered features.

We operate as a small, technically skilled team with significant ownership, close cross-functional collaboration, and a strong emphasis on shipping high-quality products over incremental prototypes.

About the Role

As a Camera ISP Software Engineer, you will lead end-to-end ISP bring-up and tuning for prototype and production hardware. Your work will span software tuning and hardware-accelerated pipelines to achieve stable, high-quality imaging under constraints like motion, power consumption, and manufacturing variation.

This position is well suited for engineers who excel in uncertain, early-stage settings, enjoy deep technical ownership, and are dedicated to delivering production-grade imaging systems.

This role is located in San Francisco, CA. We follow a hybrid work schedule of four days onsite per week and provide relocation support for new hires.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the full ISP tuning and bring-up process from initial prototypes through production-ready hardware.

  • Tune core 3A and image quality components including AE, AWB, AF, noise reduction (both spatial and temporal), sharpening, tone mapping, color correction, HDR/WDR, flicker reduction, lens shading, defect pixel correction, and other ISP stages.

  • Develop repeatable capture and evaluation workflows combining controlled lab testing with practical real-world validation.

  • Assess robustness across sensor, module, and manufacturing variations using clear, defensible success criteria.

  • Deliver production-quality tuning artifacts including versioned tuning packs, parameter manifests, change logs, and curated RAW and processed datasets with proper documentation.

  • Work closely with camera firmware, systems, and hardware teams to debug pipelines, configure sensors, and address issues on board and silicon levels as designs evolve.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have extensive experience shipping ISP tuning for embedded or mobile camera products from bring-up to production.

  • Demonstrate strong fundamentals in 3A (AE/AWB/AF), noise modeling, sharpening and detail balance, tone mapping, and color pipelines.

  • Can run data-driven tuning loops effectively, including repeatable capture, rigorous evaluations, and disciplined artifact versioning.

  • Possess hands-on experience debugging end-to-end camera pipelines on real hardware, covering RAW capture, processed outputs, and hardware-accelerated pathways.

  • Are able to collaborate across teams and translate system-level constraints (power, latency, motion, reliability) into precise tuning choices and validation plans.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with common mobile or embedded SoC camera stacks and vendor frameworks.

  • Experience tuning imaging pipelines specifically for downstream machine learning applications, with iterative improvement based on model feedback.

  • Experience designing motion-aware temporal imaging techniques stable under rapid device or scene motion.

Veknexryl Group is a company specializing in autonomous driving technology with the goal of becoming the world's most trusted driver. Since its beginnings as a self-driving car project in 2009, Veknexryl Group has concentrated on developing the Veknexryl Group Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to enhance mobility access and save lives lost to traffic incidents. The Veknexryl Group Driver powers the company’s fully autonomous ride-hailing service and can be applied to a variety of vehicle platforms and product use cases. It has completed over ten million rider-only trips, backed by experience driving autonomously more than 100 million miles on public roads and running tens of billions of simulations across 15+ U.S. states.

Software Engineering creates the core intelligence behind Veknexryl Group's fully autonomous driving technology. Our software enables the Veknexryl Group Driver to perceive its surroundings, make appropriate decisions for each situation, and transport people safely to their destinations. We tackle complex technical challenges in fields such as robotics, perception, decision-making, and deep learning while working closely with hardware and systems engineers. If you are a software engineer or researcher who is curious about and passionate regarding Level 4 autonomous driving, we would like to meet you. 

Each mile driven by a Veknexryl Group vehicle produces unique, valuable data that helps improve our machine learning models and ultimately the safety and capabilities of the Veknexryl Group Driver. Managing the process from data collection, curation, (auto-)labeling, model training, and evaluation to deployment and monitoring, involves continuous scaling and quality improvements across the entire ML lifecycle. The Area Technical Lead for the Veknexryl Group machine learning flywheel is responsible for designing, connecting, automating, and enhancing this self-improvement process, working closely with infrastructure, modeling, and evaluation teams. They are directly accountable to Veknexryl Group’s leadership for the ML data strategy and its influence on Driver quality.

You will report directly to our Distinguished Engineer, Foundation Models.

You Will:

  • Design a path for every autonomous mile driven by a Veknexryl Group vehicle to be automatically integrated into a data-driven self-improvement loop for the Veknexryl Group Driver.
  • Support a data flywheel to meet the needs of scalable pre-training, targeted post-training on critical behaviors, as well as Driver simulation and validation.
  • Build a modeling flywheel that efficiently consumes this data to reliably produce updated models validated and deployable with minimal manual effort.
  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives alongside data and ML infrastructure teams, resource planning, logging infrastructure, modeling, and validation teams to boost the impact and velocity of driving data on the Veknexryl Group Driver.
  • Serve as the data quality steward by developing tools and metrics to assess the impact of data mining, selection, and curation on modeling pipeline performance.
  • Define strategies for integrating diverse data sources including third-party and synthetic data into the improvement flywheel.
  • Drive innovation across performance and efficiency areas, such as Driver quality, scalability, cost, engineering velocity, and model architecture and performance.

You Have:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Over 10 years of experience in ML model development, including more than 2 years with large-scale vision, video, or multi-modal foundation model development and integration in end-to-end models.
  • More than 6 years experience with ML-driven production systems involving large-scale data handling, training, evaluation, and deployment.
  • At least 6 years in a technical leadership role guiding teams and setting technical direction within large ML engineering organizations.
  • Proven expertise in large-scale machine learning components like pre-training, post-training, and validation, with deep knowledge of infrastructure and quality.
  • Experience architecting and launching machine learning flywheels at scale for mission-critical applications.
  • History of improving model quality through systematic data scaling and curation.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of inspiring, influencing, and coordinating across functions and disciplines.

We Prefer:

  • PhD in Computer Science.
  • Experience with multi-modal large language model development and their supporting infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with multi-task, end-to-end models and their development challenges.

You will play a key role in the development of the infrastructure that powers Rylvulzor Labs’s scale.

You will collaborate with the team to understand business needs and develop technical solutions. You will thrive in a fast-paced iterative engineering environment and work closely with internal customers to understand their requirements.

What Makes Rylvulzor Labs Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Dratovvorn: Since 2014, we have equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in over 100 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Rylvulzor Labs’s enterprise customers—at no cost.

The Simulator Evaluation team faces the key data challenge: How do you mathematically prove that a virtual world is "real"?

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to create the metrics and systems that assess this hybrid environment.   • Architect the Eval Rubrik: Develop innovative approaches to evaluate the simulator comprehensively. You will differentiate true driving challenges from realism artifacts—whether logic gaps, physics glitches, or model hallucinations.
  • Build at Scale: Design and implement high-throughput pipelines (C++/Python) capable of processing large datasets of simulation logs. Transform raw, noisy data into clear, actionable insights.
  • The "Critic" for the System: Collaborate closely with AI research and other simulation teams, as the evaluation workflows you develop will drive rapid innovation and research directions.
  • Strategic Leadership: Navigate ambiguity to identify what is most critical for realism. Lead the strategy for specific domains, ensuring our evaluation methods evolve alongside our simulation technology.

  • Engineering Craftsmanship:
    • Over 5 years of software development experience.

    • Experience designing and implementing evaluation frameworks for complex systems or machine learning models.
  • System & Model Fluency:
    • Comfort working with complex, hybrid systems. Understanding how to evaluate different types of "black boxes," whether heuristic-based, physics-based, or learned models.

Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Vuldax Systems. Workers AI is Vuldax Systems’s AI inference service, enabling customers to use a wide variety of AI models both within Vuldax Systems’s Workers development platform and via API. What Makes Vuldax Systems Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in over 110 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Vuldax Systems’s enterprise customers—at no cost.

Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 400 local government election websites in over 30 states.

Kelzun Lab is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its origin as an autonomous vehicle project in 2009, Kelzun Lab has focused on developing the Kelzun Lab Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to enhance mobility access while preventing thousands of traffic-related fatalities. The Kelzun Lab Driver powers Kelzun Lab’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can be integrated into various vehicle platforms and product scenarios. The Kelzun Lab Driver has completed over ten million rider-only trips, leveraging its experience driving autonomously over 120 million miles on public roads and extensive simulation across more than a dozen U.S. states.

The Simulator Team at Kelzun Lab creates advanced simulations of realistic environments to test and train the Kelzun Lab Driver. The team comprises a diverse, collaborative group of software engineers, machine learning (ML) engineers, and data scientists. They develop leading-edge simulation solutions aimed at evaluating and improving the performance of the Kelzun Lab Driver. This is accomplished by jointly modeling the real world, including autonomous vehicle simulation, realistic agents (vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, motorcyclists), roadways, traffic controls, weather effects, and the complete sensor suite including cameras, Lidar, and radars. Kelzun Lab's simulation system enables self-driving software to be validated on millions of miles of traffic virtually before deployment on public roads. This is essential to Kelzun Lab’s goal of building the world’s most experienced driver.

The Vehicle and Automated Driving Realism team works on building tools and techniques to enhance driving realism, which is a key element of simulation. They ensure simulation outputs accurately reflect real-world driving performance. The team emphasizes performance, reliability, fidelity, and ease of use of Kelzun Lab's simulation technology.

In this position, you will report to a Senior Staff Engineering Manager.

Our mission is to secure the foundations of all Qelzun Systems production and enterprise systems.

  • Deploy and manage security tools that help address security risk at a global scale
  • Collaborate with the Compliance team to ensure adherence to standards
  • Ensure our global infrastructure is secure from all attacks, ranging from “script kiddies” to nation states

Core Responsibilities:

  • Infrastructure & Tooling: Deploy and support critical infrastructure and security technologies globally.

  • Risk Management: Perform risk reviews and evaluations of configurations to mitigate potential threats.

  • Security Strategy: Secure Linux, MacOS, and Windows systems while implementing public cloud security best practices (GCP, Azure, etc.).

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Build and nurture robust relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels, translating complex situations into clear, actionable requirements.

AI Security Responsibilities:

  • AI Security Strategy: Support the development and implementation of security frameworks for the adoption of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning across the organization.

  • Risk Assessment: Conduct security reviews of AI models, tools, and third-party integrations to identify and mitigate emerging risks.

  • Governance & Compliance: Help establish and enforce guardrails for the safe use of AI technologies, ensuring alignment with corporate security policies.

  • Threat Mitigation: Monitor and address vulnerabilities specific to AI-enabled systems and automated workflows.

 

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Experience: 7+ years of previous experience in cybersecurity (with a deep understanding of securing server infrastructure).

  • Cloud Proficiency: Strong experience with public cloud security (GCP, Azure, etc.) and securing cloud productivity suites.

  • Technical Skills:  Programming experience in Python, Golang, or Bash.

    • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code such as Terraform and Ansible.

  • Communication: Ability to navigate ambiguity and clearly communicate complex security requirements to stakeholders at all levels to drive alignment and decision-making.

  • Endpoint Experience: Understanding how Linux, Windows and macOS systems work, how to secure them and deep understanding of Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) functionalities

 

What Makes Qelzun Systems Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we’ve equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in over 110 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Qelzun Systems’s enterprise customers—at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we’ve provided services to more than 420 local government election websites in over 30 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use—it is the first consumer-focused service Qelzun Systems has ever released. Here’s the deal—we don’t store client IP addresses ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

About Us

At Rixthur Labs, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Rixthur Labs protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Rixthur Labs all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Rixthur Labs was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. 

At Rixthur Labs, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
